title: Caravaning across Africa with Divya & artists Shikhant and Shivi
summary: Divya talks with artist-comic-maker Shikhant Sablania and cinematographer Shivi Bhatnagar about The Great African Caravan — their eight-month journey from Cape Town to Cairo making art and documentary with local communities. They cover meeting in South Africa, teaching filmmaking to teenage girls in underprivileged schools, the challenges of running workshops with kids, and collaborating with a partner whose practice is different from your own.

intents.display: to hear two artists who caravanned across africa making art
to think about teaching art and film to kids in underserved schools
